desc: Implement the row/column elimination parity-DSU solver with the correct B equation weight, row/column A-parity checks, active component count, and all-A row/column free bits.
Optimize the implementation for T up to 1e5 and total HW up to 1e6: fast tokenized input, iterative parity find, union by size, and early skipping after a case becomes invalid.
Validate against the sample tests and a brute-force edge-bit enumerator for tiny grids to verify prefix offsets and Type-B complement behavior.
Finalize clean stdin/stdout code with no debug output.
